headline: Kurzweil joins a nasal-spray BCI startup; open models keep coming
body: A mixed day of six smaller stories. Ray Kurzweil became an adviser to Subsense, a preclinical non-surgical brain-computer interface startup, nudging Human-AI Merging and lifting Descendants (humanity handing over to digital heirs). DeepSeek's planned 160,000-chip Huawei cluster and an Nvidia model beating the top human at the 2026 Informatics Olympiad added Capability Velocity. MBZUAI's fully open K2 Horizon models eased Power Concentration, and solid US August jobs numbers helped Shared Prosperity, together lifting the Libertarian and Egalitarian utopias. A US probe into Tesla Cybercabs without steering wheels trimmed AI Autonomy. Horizon Balance edged up to -5.03.
movers_note: Descendants +0.3 from the Kurzweil BCI news (+0.19) plus DeepSeek and Nvidia; Libertarian Utopia +0.2 from K2 Horizon (+0.10) and Subsense (+0.10); Egalitarian Utopia +0.2 from the jobs report (+0.13).
coming_up: DeepSeek's 1GW Ulanqab inference site targeted for late 2027 or early 2028
